purpose: Descriptive current-champion error analysis, not independent confirmation or a new model score
label: v250_eight_rms_72k

method.score_source: float32 NPZ score promoted to float64; no model inference or training
method.tail_mask: score <= p10; ties may exceed exactly 400 of 4000 UE observations
method.snr_assignment: own UE SNR, not pair minimum SNR

interpretation: Low own-SNR UE dominate the P10 neighborhood; this motivates future separately registered hypotheses, not immediate reweighting or adoption of temperature0.25.
caveat: Same 2000 channels recur across noise seeds. Counts are UE/noise observations, not independent samples. The reused selection cohort and historical provenance limitations preclude global-blind or online claims.
